        "fields",

        "to",

        "height",

        "width_factor",
        "oblique",
        "height",
        "if_exists"

        "base_point",
        "entities*",
        "attributes",
        "if_exists"

      "summary": "Delete a layer",
      "params": [
        "name*",
        "delete_entities"
      ]

      "op": "draw_order",
      "category": "edit",

        "target*",
        "order*"
      ]

      "op": "explode",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Explode block references (INSERT) or polylines into their component entities",
      "params": [
        "target*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "extend",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "AutoCAD EXTEND: lengthen a LINE end until it meets the nearest boundary edge",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "edges*",
        "end"
      ]
    },

      "op": "fillet",

        "line2*",
        "radius*"

      "draw_params": true

      "op": "insert_block",
      "category": "block",

      "params": [
        "name*",
        "insert*",
        "scale",
        "rotation",
        "attributes"
      ],
      "draw_params": true

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "tolerance",
        "tag"
      ]
    },

      "op": "mirror",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Mirror entities about the line p1-p2",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "p1*",
        "p2*",
        "keep_original"
      ]
    },

      "op": "modify",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Set fields of ONE entity, e.g",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "set*"
      ]

      "op": "modify_layer",

        "name*",
        "color",
        "linetype",
        "lineweight",
        "on",
        "frozen",
        "locked",
        "new_name"
      ]
    },

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "delta",
        "base",
        "to"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "offset",
      "category": "edit",

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "distance*",
        "side_point"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "purge",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "AutoCAD PURGE: delete layers, blocks, text styles and linetypes that nothing uses",
      "params": [
        "kinds"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "rotate",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Rotate entities about a center point (degrees, CCW)",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "angle*",
        "center*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "scale",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Uniformly scale entities about a base point",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "factor*",
        "center*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "set_annotation_scale",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Set the plot scale 1:scale for annotations: dimension arrows/text/gaps (DIMSCALE) and linetype dash lengths (LTSCALE) are multiplied by 'scale'",
      "params": [
        "scale*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "set_attributes",
      "category": "block",
      "summary": "Set attribute values of block references",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "values*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "set_properties",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Change layer / color / linetype / lineweight / tag of entities",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "layer",
        "color",
        "linetype",
        "lineweight",
        "tag"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "stretch",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "AutoCAD STRETCH with a crossing window: entities entirely inside move; LINE end points, polyline vertices and dimension definition points inside the window move; circles/arcs/text/blocks move if their center/insert point is inside",
      "params": [
        "window*",
        "delta*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "trim",
      "category": "edit",

      ]
    }

   改正后第二次校验 20/20 通过。

- 外轮廓 200 × 100，一条封闭轮廓

- 尺寸标注数值 200、100、160、Ø40 都没变
- 两处文字内容都没变
- 各图层对象数量和上面的归层一致；Layout1 图纸空间是空的

- **线型和线宽是否已随层没有直接核实**：改属性的操作执行成功了，但 `get_diff` 只列出了颜色和图层的变化，没有线型、线宽的改动。很可能原图里这两项本来就是随层，但我没法证实。可以在 AutoCAD 里抽查几个对象确认。
- **尺寸标注自身的颜色设置没检查**：标注样式或标注对象里可能单独指定了尺寸线、文字的颜色，这次没有查，也没有改。
- **线型比例没调**：CENTER 线型的显示效果取决于线型比例（LTSCALE），我没有调整。
